verdict.rationale: LocalAI publishes a documentation site, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. Direct probes found no such docs: https://localai.io/llms.txt returned 404, the markdown variant of the docs page returned 404, and every candidate OpenAPI spec path returned 404. Nothing in the pack shows another agent-readable docs format; the MCP and agent features describe runtime capabilities, not documentation an agent can be pointed at.
